title: Jubilant Slovakian Cheese Bake
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring fermented cheese and shortcrust pastry, wrapped in a ti leaf and baked to perfection, this ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a delight to indulge in. It combines the richness of cheese with the crunch of pastry and the unique flavor of fermented ingredients.

ingredients.name: fermented cheese
ingredients.notes: such as feta or goat cheese

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the fermented cheese, eggs, sour cream, chopped fresh dill, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Place the cheese mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water.
Fold the pastry over the cheese mixture, pressing the edges to seal.
Wrap the pastry in a ti leaf, making sure to cover it completely.
Place the wrapped pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
